description: This file is a Python module for handling PDF files, including extracting text, creating thumbnails, and embedding metadata into PDFs.

methods.name: pdf_text_extract
methods.description: Extracts text from a PDF file using the plain_text_output function, with options for sorting and hyphen removal.

methods.name: pdf_thumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail image from the first page of a PDF document, resizing and enhancing sharpness.

methods.name: pdf_meta_embed
methods.description: Embeds metadata into a copy of the PDF file, updating various metadata fields.
